paras: Eurolophosaurus nanuzae, also known commonly as Rodrigues's lava lizard and lagartinho-de-crista-do-espinhaço in Brazilian Portuguese, is a species of South American lava lizard in the family Tropiduridae. The species is endemic to Brazil.
The specific name, nanuzae, is in honor of Brazilian botanist Nanuza Luiza de Menezes.
Eurolophosaurus nanuzae is found in eastern Brazil, in the Brazilian states of Bahia and Minas Gerais.
The preferred natural habitat of Eurolophosaurus nanuzae is rocky shrubland, at elevations above 900 m (3,000 ft).
Eurolophosaurus nanuzae is terrestrial, saxicolous (rock-dwelling), and diurnal.
Eurolophosaurus nanuzae preys predominately upon termites and ants.
